title: Silver and Black Pride accepts Bears’ (WCG’s) offer for Maxx Crosby

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Silver and Black Pride accepts Bears’ (WCG’s) offer for Maxx Crosby
sources.description: SB Nation’s Las Vegas Raiders site, Silver and Black Pride, asked for offers on Maxx Crosby. The Chicago Bears, aka Windy City Gridiron, put the best offer on the table.
